Diego L: Heads up 18  Horizon asked for a plain-language SLO + credit playbook we can hand to procurement. Need by COB.
Priya S: Got it. Can we make a two-page "what we measure" + "how credits work" doc? Keep math examples simple.
Rina T: Yes. I'll sketch the measurement section: route filters, aggregation (p95), and blackout windows.
Ben H: For credits, legal wants an easy formula and cap. My proposal: credit = min(Commitment * factor, Cap). Factor = downtime_ratio * severity_weight.
Diego L: Can you write that as a sample calc we can show? Procurement prefers numbers not words.
Ben H: Example snippet for the doc:
```
minutes_in_month = 30 * 24 * 60
downtime_minutes = measured_downtime - permitted_exclusions
downtime_ratio = downtime_minutes / minutes_in_month
credit = min(monthly_commitment * 0.75 * downtime_ratio, monthly_commitment * 0.5)
```
This yields capped credits (max 50% of monthly commit).
Priya S: Nice. Add one concrete example: small account $4k/mo, 60 minutes downtime -> credit = ? (show calc).
Rina T: I'll add an enterprise example with Dedicated pool fallback: show credit when Dedicated unavailable but Hosted served at higher latency (partial credit).
Alert Bot: Maintenance scheduled: telemetry pipeline upgrade 2026-03-21T02:00Z (30m). Metrics ingestion may be delayed.
Diego L: Note: maintenance windows must be excluded from measured downtime. We'll add a section "Permitted Exclusions" in the playbook.
Priya S: Also add the claim process: 1) customer opens claim with incident timestamp 2) CS uploads evidence bundle 3) SRE validates metrics 4) Legal approves payout. SLA: claims submitted within 14 days.
Ben H: Agree. Also include required evidence list: incident ID, Console p95 screenshot, trace IDs, sampling config. Mention redaction of hostnames.
Rina T: For onboarding linkage: map these items to activation gates (API keys, model pin, warm traffic verification). We should define "acceptance window" (14 days post warmup) where p95 must be met for acceptance.
Diego L: Good. For renewal risk, note: if p95 misses >3 times in a rolling 90d window, trigger renewal review + remediation plan. Add this to account health notes.
Priya S: I'll draft the two-pager and add a short FAQ: "When will credits appear on invoice?" answer: within 30 days after claim approval.
Ben H: I'll produce the sample tables (small/medium/enterprise) and an appendix for Dedicated math.
Rina T: I uploaded a working draft: https://redwood.app/drafts/horizon-playbook-v1 (comments open).
Diego L: Scheduling: let's do a 25min walkthrough with Horizon this afternoon 3:30pm PT. Rina, can you join for metrics deep-dive?
Rina T: Yes. Priya, can you handle invites and include procurement contacts?
Priya S: On it. Sending invite now.
Alert Bot: Auto-ticket CS-5021 created for Horizon SLO playbook.
Diego L: Post-call action: publish final one-pager to the Account Health doc and set a renewal flag if they opt into regional 150ms p95 requirement.
Priya S: Will capture meeting notes in CS-5021 and attach the draft.
Ben H: One more note: warmup priming responsibility is shared. We'll own server-side priming for 24h after model pin; customer responsible for repeated long-tail traffic patterns.
Diego L: Thanks team. If we get agreement on the capped credit formula and acceptance window, procurement should sign quickly. :thumbsup:
